Leader Garden also known as Taman Leader, is a freehold condominium situated at Jalan Chee Seng, Tanjung Bungah, Penang. 
Leader Garden comprises of 2 blocks of 21-storey high rise and 1 block of 5-storey low rise. The whole development consists of a total of 428 units with 420 being their standard units and the remaining are penthouse units. Their standard units have a built-up area ranging from 1,050 sf to 1,100 sf whilst the penthouse units all have a built-up area of approximately 1,830 sf. Standard units in Leader Garden are equipped with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.
Leader Garden provides an extensive amount of facilities including swimming pool, wading pool, water slide, 2 squash courts, tennis court, table tennis, gymnasium, sauna, playground, a huge landscaped garden, parking lots & around the clock security.
Well known malls like Gurney Plaza & Gurney Paragon are just about a 12 minutes’ drive away via Jalan Tanjung Bungah where residents can find ample amenities like banks, restaurants, boutiques, saloons, clinics, pharmacies, nightlife entertainments and more.
Apart from that, the famous Gurney Drive is located just around the corner where ample local cuisines can be found. And whenever there is any medical emergency, there are a Klinik Kesihatan Tanjung Bungah located just a short 3 minutes’ drive away and Tejani Medical Centre located just a 5 minutes’ short drive away from the condominium.
Prominent schools like the Dalat International School or TAR College Penang are both located within less than a 10 minutes’ drive from Leader Garden which is perfect for foreigners or those who are preparing to go to college to further their studies. Other schools such as SRJK Poay Wah are also situated within close proximity to Leader Garden.
Connectivity wise, Leader Garden can be easily reached via Jalan Tanjung Bungah are Jalan Batu Feringghi. There are also multiple public transportation options available like the Tanjung Bungah Rapid Penang Bus Hub, Batu Feringghi Taxi Stand, Penang Hill Upper Station and Penang Hill Upper Tunnel Station, all positioned no further than a 5km radius away from Leader Garden.

description:
Simfoni 1
Simfoni 1 is a leasehold condominium project situated in Semenyih, Selangor. This development was completed in 2016 by SSH Group, an experienced developer with a tally of 2000 units of residential and commercial properties developed and sold in Kajang.
Simfoni 1 Concept
Simfoni 1 consists of 21 floors encompassing 336 units. The first floor consists of retail outlets, providing the residences with their daily needs without needing to travel far. 2 levels of covered parking lots are available for tenants and visitors. This condominium project is also equipped with a swimming and wading pool, a gymnasium, sauna, nursery, children’s play area, surau, sky lounge, open bazaar, and a multipurpose hall. Round the clock security is also in place to ensure that the residents can go on with their daily lives in comfort and safety.
Simfoni 1 Accessibility And Amenities
Kajang, the ‘Satay Town’, is a quiet township undergoing gentrification situated 20KMs southeast of downtown Kuala Lumpur, a mere 30-minute drive away. Access to other neighbourhoods is made easy by a network of highways running across the city: the Cheras-Kajang highway, the SILK highway, the Kajang-Semenyih Bypass, the North-South highway, the Kajang-Seremban highway, and the Damansara-Puchong Expressway (LDP). The local railway service: Kajang KTM/ MRT station is available to service the locals and feeder buses are also available to facilitate transportation. Kajang has a few shopping centres to cater to the needs of local shoppers: Tesco, Giant Hypermarkets, The Billion Shopping Centre, Kompleks Kota Kajang, Winnie Plaza, and Metro Plaza Kajang. Many education hubs also dot the map, catering to its growing population: SMK Kajang Utama, SK Kajang Utama, SJK (T) West Country, and SMK Jalan Reko. Kajang houses multiple institute of higher learning such as Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman, Universiti Kuala Lumpur Medical Science and Technologi,Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia, the University of Nottingham Campus, the Kuala Lumpur Infrastructure University College, and the German-Malaysia Institute. Many healthcare centres, both private and public are available locally, ready to respond to any emergencies: Hospital Serdang, Hospital Putrajaya, Kajang Hospital, Kajang Medical Plaza and KPJ Kajang Specialist Hospital, among others. Kajang also has plenty of other amenities such as a sports stadium, a wet market, post offices, petrol kiosks, clinics, banks and business centres.

Each unit at Pertiwi Indah comes with about 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Standard apartment facilities are provided for residents like parking, playground as well as security. As the apartment is located within close proximity to Cheras, residents have easy access to an abundance of amenities.
A multitude of schools are within close proximity to Pertiwi Indah. Many of these schools are only a short walk or drive away such as the SJK Tsun Jin, Sekolah Sri Garden, SK St. Gabriel, SK Puteri Pandan 2, SMK Datok Lokman and SMK Taman Maluri; all of which are situated within close range from one another. There are quite a few more higher education institutions that are located a short drive away.
Transportation is hassle free as residents of Pertiwi Indah has easy access to SMART tunnel which can be accessed via Jalan Perkasa. It is also serviced by a number of major highways like MRR2 and KL-Putrajaya highway. Public transportation are also available, such as RapidKL Pandan Jaya which is about 1 km away. Several transportation hubs can be found along SMART tunnel as well.
Analysis:
Pertiwi Indah is ideal for young families with children and on a tight budget. Developments within the area are unrivaled in terms affordability in conjunction with convenience. Residents will not have to travel far to send their children to school, in fact, certain schools are within walking distance, completely eliminating the need to drive.

The ERA is a mixed development of serviced residences and retail components, set to bring vibrant city living to Duta North, the fast-developing region of Segambut just north of Dutamas and Mont Kiara. Spanning 14.8 acres of land, the development will comprise of 6 complexes, which will tower at heights of 53 to 63 storeys tall. The podium will house retail spaces, with a combined area of 277,000 sf, and also includes an 8-storey car park, while plans for offices are also in talks.
The ERA is a freehold development, which is poised to offer 3 different phases of serviced residences which go by the themes of DAWN, NOON, and EVE. The units are sized between a comfortable 614 sf to a colossal 2,928 sf, with the first phase set to see the release of 921 of these serviced suites.
More than 100 facilities are planned for The ERA, where life in the city can mean much more than leaving home during the day and coming home just to sleep. At The ERA, residents are encouraged to take a breather whenever needed, with a range of nature-centred facilities offered, like the Forest Village, where lush foliage will make residents forget that they are in the city. Within will also be adventure trails, a water maze, hanging pavilions, tree houses, and more. Making the most of their soaring heights, there will also be a Sky Lounge and Moon Deck, which will enable stunning city views. Other features include a 100-metre pool, Sports Clubhouse, as well as banquet hall and gourmet kitchens for entertaining guests.
Location is the hallmark of The ERA’s appeal to city dwellers, with a range of amenities and points of connectivity all within reach. Aside from the retail outlets within The ERA, the neighbourhood of Mont Kiara and Dutamas, both about 4km away, provide conveniences ranging from restaurants, cafes, grocery stores, banks, clinics, and more. Publika (4km) is the nearest mall, while schools in the area are also aplenty, namely the Mont’Kiara International School, and the Garden International School (GIS). Other amenities within reach include KLCC (8km), The Curve (11km), and 1 Utama (12km).
Connectivity from The ERA to Mont Kiara and Dutamas will be even more convenient, with a proposed link bridge which will enable direct access to these neighbourhoods. On top of that, The ERA is situated off Jalan Kuching, which leads straight to the KL city centre (7km), as well as connect to highways such as the Duta-Ulu Kelang Expressway (DUKE), Lebuhraya Sultan Iskandar, the SPRINT Highway (and the Penchala Link).
